verdict.rationale: Jeeves documents role/permission customization ('customize roles & permissions', 'employee permissions', 'manage user permissions') and card/spend limits, but evidence is limited to marketing blurbs without detail on granularity across locations/departments, admin UI, or role hierarchy configuration. missing for 10: detailed documentation of role types/permission scopes, department/location-level access control specifics, and independent/hands-on verification of granularity.
